invariant.portable_principle: Move standalone paths deterministically and rewrite only identity-resolved non-source references while surfacing unsupported source-import risk.
invariant.python_or_framework_mechanism: Existing Python filesystem virtual-after-tree mover, reference resolver, report writer, and YAML compatibility path.
invariant.typescript_mechanism: Move .ts/.tsx paths; resolve Markdown/HTML/config/backtick/exact-text identities; record local static imports whose target or referrer is moved without changing source text.

reference_repairs: Added a stdlib JSON plan path because requiring PyYAML for JSON plans broke copied-skill closure.

known_false_positives: A static relative import or conventional NodeNext emitted/source pair may be recorded even when host compiler configuration resolves it differently; it remains an advisory risk, not a rewrite.
known_false_negatives: Unusual import syntax, nonstandard emitted/source mappings, package imports, dynamic imports, aliases, package exports, project references, and compiler-specific resolution are not recorded.
legitimate_similar_shapes: External URLs and prose containing old path-looking text stay unchanged.
Unrelated local TypeScript imports stay unchanged and do not appear as moved-import risks.
